topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: Adaptive beamforming, spatial multiplexing, and hybrid beamforming ensure consistent LOS connectivity. Adaptive algorithms track the dominant LOS path, reducing Rician fading. Spatial multiplexing enhances reliability, while hybrid beamforming balances performance and complexity. Beam splitting and machine learning further optimize beam direction and width.
reference_context: Aeronautical communications involve A2G, A2A, and A2S links with rapidly fluctuating frequency-selective fading and Rician distributed fading.
